messages:
maria: urgent exec escalation — Moneyball Analytics is pausing the POC. CISO says no go until SSO + BYO KMS attestation + clarified pricing floor. They want an exec touchpoint today. can we mobilize?

samir: on standby. can you paste the CISO asks? is this about service-level keys or customer-managed keys?

maria: quick summary from their security questionnaire: SAML2 IdP (Okta) required, SCIM provisioning, SCIM sync every 4 hours, and BYO KMS with key wrapping + HSM attestation. also they asked for a pricing commitment cap and a temporary discount for POC volume. questionnaire: https://drive.internal/moneyball/sec-qna (link from AE).

elaine: we can support SAML + SCIM and a Private deployment with BYO KMS. legal/infra need the attestation pattern though — usually we require an encryption key-wrapping shim and an import workflow. I'll sketch runbook. ETA 48h for a security runbook and deployment checklist.

jonah: for private deployment we also need their egress / peering targets and expected qps. plz have them send an allowlist (CIDR) and expected token/sec. if they're doing on-prem peering we'll request BGP/ASN details.

maria: copied details from CISO: they want a host-based attestation report, KMS key lifecycle controls, and proof of no plaintext exfiltration. Also asked whether logs can be forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk).

nina: legal POV — SCIM + SAML are fine. I'll need the final questionnaire responses to draft a DPA + security addendum and the SCIM clause. turnaround ~3 business days once I have the questionnaire and an SOW draft. If VP or revenue ok with a POC credit we can do a short-form addendum.

vic: I can join the customer call today at 16:00 PT. maria please lock that time. We should be prepared to offer a pragmatic POC path (technical + legal + pricing) to remove blockers.

maria: confirmed 16:00 PT for customer exec bridge. agenda: 1) tech fit (elaine/jonah) 2) legal/KMS attestation (nina) 3) commercial (vic/samir) 4) next steps.

maria: customer request on pricing: they want a 30% POC discount and a cap on token spend for the POC quarter. is there flexibility on an intro credit/discount?

samir: short-term options: a) hosted POC with token cap + credit b) Dedicated trial with reduced rate for first 90 days c) Private deployment with one-time implementation fee + credit. we can model cost + unit economics — i'll draft numbers before the call.

vic: approved to offer a one-time POC credit up to $50k and a 20% off introductory rate for first 3 months if they commit to a short trial SOW. legal to draft a handwaveable addendum.

elaine: I'll assemble a technical runbook (SSO mapping, SCIM attributes, KMS import/wrap commands). snippet for their infra team:
```
# example: key import wrapper (pseudo)
$ redwoodctl key import --kms-provider=cloud-hsm --wrap-algo=rsa-oaep --key-id=moneyball-poc
```
I'll post the full runbook to the shared doc in ~24h.

jonah: noting infra tasks: 1) collect allowlist CIDRs 2) expected concurrent sessions 3) test token samples (non-prod). once we have those we'll do a smoke network test.

carmen: i'm prepping the customer invite and will share dial-in + pre-read. will include link to the questionnaire and runbook draft when available.

nina: will draft the DPA + SCIM clause and circulate a short-form security addendum for POC credit. pls tag me if legal needs to be on the call.

deploy-bot: runbook created (draft) -> https://deploy.internal/runbooks/moneyball-poc-draft (automatic message) :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks team. owners: samir -> pricing offer draft, elaine -> technical runbook, jonah -> network checklist, nina -> legal addendum, vic -> exec call. target: have all artifacts ready 2 hours before the 16:00 PT call. i'll follow up with a quick pre-brief 90 min before.

vic: :thumbsup: let's remove blockers. maria, pls share customer exec dial-in and any redlines immediately.

maria: will do. closing for now — will reopen thread after pre-brief.
